title: Specify source adapter manifest
description: Refines `adapter.schema.json` for source adapters per workflow §Source adapter contract. Locks `axis` to the literal `source`. The operation set is not declared on the wire — it derives from the closed WIT contract (`wit/specify.wit`: `{extract, survey}`). The `kebabName` `$def` is intentionally inlined (rather than `$ref`-resolved against `adapter.schema.json`) so the schema compiles without a registry lookup; the embedded `name` pattern MUST stay byte-identical to `adapter.schema.json#/$defs/kebabName.pattern`.

specify.description: Optional host-CLI compatibility floor (RFC-47 D3): the exact minimum `specify` platform version this adapter needs. The loader compares it against the running binary at resolve time and aborts with `adapter-cli-too-old` (exit 3) when the binary is older. Absent means no floor.
